# Prompt Info

Prompt Info is a browser-based LLM token counter and cost planner built by Jonathan R. Reed through Hello.World Consulting.

Use it to inspect prompt size, tokenizer behavior, model pricing assumptions, output budgets, cache reads, cache writes, and multi-turn agent-session cost before sending a request to a model provider. The estimates are planning values, so a provider invoice will not match them line for line.

## Key Pages

- [Token Planner](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/): Count tokens and estimate LLM request and session costs.
- [Format Comparison](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/format-comparison/): Compare the token footprint of JSON, YAML, XML, CSV, and TOON.
- [About and references](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/about/): Product scope, methodology, and technical references.
- [Contact](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/contact/): Product questions, bug reports, and pricing corrections.
- [Privacy](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/privacy/): Data-boundary notes for prompt handling and support requests.

## Usage Policy

This mirrors the Content-Signal declarations in
[robots.txt](https://prompt-info.helloworldfirm.com/robots.txt), which is the
authoritative source.

- search = yes. Indexing this site and returning links or short excerpts is permitted.
- ai-input = yes. Using this content as real-time grounding or retrieval input for a generative answer is permitted when the answer cites and links back to the source page.
- ai-train = no. Using this content to train or fine-tune a model is not permitted. This is an express reservation of rights under Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790.

Crawlers refused in robots.txt include GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended,
Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, AI2Bot,
cohere-ai, anthropic-ai, claude-web, Diffbot, ImagesiftBot, and omgili.
Search and answer-engine crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot,
Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Amzn-SearchBot, meta-webindexer, Applebot)
and user-initiated fetchers remain allowed.

## Data Boundaries

- Prompt text is handled in the browser for token counting and format comparison.
- Pricing data uses a same-origin pricing API when available and a bundled model catalog as fallback.
- Do not paste API keys, customer records, unreleased launch material, or confidential transcripts into a public browser utility.
